item.title: Melco Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction Efforts in Gyirong County, Xizang
item.description:
>
Melco Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction Efforts in Gyirong County, Xizang Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited announced today (4th) that, with the full assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao Special Administrative Region, it has donated MOP 5 million to support disaster relief and post-disaster reconstruction in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, following recent mudslides.   The mudslides severely impacted the Gyirong Port area, causing road blockages, damage to homes and infrastructure, as well as significant casualties and missing persons. The donation will be utilized to supply and distribute emergency relief materials, provide temporary shelter and medical aid for displaced residents, and assist affected families in rebuilding their homes and restoring normal life as quickly as possible.   Mr. Lawrence Ho, Chairman and CEO of Melco, stated that all colleagues are deeply saddened by the severe casualties caused by this natural disaster. He expressed heartfelt sympathy for the families of the victims, the missing, and the disaster-stricken residents, while offering condolences and encouragement to the frontline rescue teams. As a company rooted in Macao, Melco has long remained committed to corporate social responsibility. Through this contribution, the company hopes to extend practical support to the people of Gyirong County and will continue to follow the area’s reconstruction progress, wishing the affected residents a swift recovery and rebuild of their homes.

item.title: Wynn Launches 20th Anniversary Share Award to Express Gratitude to Team Members and Share Success
item.description:
>
Wynn Launches 20th Anniversary Share Award to Express Gratitude to Team Members and Share Success Wynn Macau, Limited (1128) has announced the launch of a one-time “Wynn Macau 20th Anniversary Share Award”, under which eligible team members of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace will be granted shares in Wynn Macau, Limited. Through this initiative, Wynn aims to extend appreciation to team members for their outstanding contributions over the years and share the company’s success. Nearly 95% of the company’s current full-time workforce of 11,660 will benefit from this initiative, reflecting Wynn’s commitment to recognizing and rewarding talent while encouraging team members to grow alongside the company and create long-term value together.   Ms. Linda Chen, President, Vice Chairman, and Executive Director of Wynn Macau, Limited, stated in her speech at the anniversary event that Wynn Macau’s achievements over the past two decades would not have been possible without the Central Government’s support for Macao through its various policies and the strong support of the Macao SAR Government. She also expressed her deep gratitude to the Wynn Macau team members and their families for working side by side with her over the past 20 years to drive the company’s continuous growth. She commended team members for being united by a shared sense of purpose and aspiration, dedicating themselves to showcasing Macao’s renowned hospitality and exceptional service to guests from around the world, while actively giving back to the community and continuing to contribute to Macao’s development and well-being.   More than 1,400 day-one team members have remained with the company since the opening of Wynn Macau in 2006. They gathered at the anniversary event to look back on the cherished journey of working alongside the company and Macao over the past two decades. Wynn Macau paid tribute to their 20 years of dedicated service, presenting each eligible day-one team member with a 20-year service certificate and a Wynn 20th Anniversary Share Award valued at MOP 50,000. Looking ahead, Wynn and its team members will continue to uphold the shared vision of “Two Decades of Shared Success, Committed to Partnership for a Sustainable Future”, further strengthening their commitment to Macao and working together for a brighter future.

item.title: 金沙中國捐出1000萬 支援西藏吉隆救災工作
item.description:
>
金沙中國捐出1000萬元，支援西藏吉隆救災工作。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣日前遭受泥石流災害，造成重大人員傷亡，災情嚴峻。金沙中國今天(4日)宣佈，將透過澳門中聯辦的全力協助，向西藏自治區捐出1,000萬澳門元，以實際行動支援災區救援及重建工作，並將澳門同胞的關愛與牽掛送往災區，為當地居民送上支持與力量。 金沙中國行政副主席王英偉表示，金沙中國心繫祖國，對災害帶來的重大傷亡與損失深感痛惜，向遇難者致哀、慰問受災同胞。金沙中國將透過捐款支援災區救援、民眾安置及災後重建，盼助災民渡過難關，堅信災區定能戰勝困境、重建家園。

item.title: Modified Clothing Used to Hide Phones for Baccarat Live Stream Betting: Judiciary Police Arrested Three Men and Seizes 220,000 in Cash and Chips
item.description:
>
Modified Clothing Used to Hide Phones for Baccarat Live Stream Betting: Judiciary Police Arrested Three Men and Seizes 220,000 in Cash and Chips Macau busted an illegal proxy betting operation at a casino in Cotai early Tuesday (September 1), arresting a Macau resident and two mainland men. The suspects allegedly used modified clothing to conceal mobile phones, illegally filming and live-streaming baccarat tables to allow mainland gamblers to place bets remotely. The operation resulted in the seizure of cash and chips valued at 220,000 Hong Kong dollars, alongside various tools used in the crime.   The arrested individuals include a 43-year-old local businessman named Lao, as well as two unemployed mainland men, a 37-year-old named Guo and a 29-year-old named Qiao. Upon receiving a report early Tuesday morning, Judiciary Police officers rushed to the scene and intercepted the three suspects while they were actively operating at a baccarat table.   According to the investigation, two of the suspects wore modified tops outfitted with hidden pockets and small holes to fix mobile phones to their chests. They covertly filmed the gaming table and transmitted the live feed to mainland clients via streaming software, receiving betting instructions through miniature Bluetooth earpieces while the third suspect recorded the wins and losses nearby. Driven by the desire to earn extra income, Qiao claimed he was promised 300 RMB in compensation, Guo had accumulated 2,500 RMB in profits since operating in August, and Lao’s exact illicit earnings remain under investigation.   Police seized several mobile phones, Wi-Fi routers, miniature earpieces, and modified clothing from the three suspects. The case has been transferred to the Public Prosecutions Office for further investigation, with the suspects facing charges related to the illegal operation of online games of chance or online mutual betting.

item.title: GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation Donate MOP10 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang
item.description:
>
GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation Donate MOP10 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang To support emergency relief efforts and accelerate post-disaster recovery in the mudslide-affected areas of Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, Galaxy Entertainment Group (GEG) announced on Thursday (September 3) that, with the full assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao Special Administrative Region, GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation will jointly donate MOP10 million. The donation will be used exclusively to support emergency search and rescue operations, relief supplies, temporary resettlement of affected residents, medical assistance, and subsequent disaster reconstruction and recovery efforts in the affected communities.   A severe mudslide recently struck Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region. This sudden natural disaster caused extensive damage to local transportation networks, infrastructure, and residents’ livelihoods, as well as significant casualties and property losses, drawing widespread concern across the nation.   Mr. Francis Lui, Chairman of GEG, expressed his deep concern for the affected compatriots, his profound sadness over the devastating mudslide in Gyirong County, his sincere sympathies to the affected residents, and his highest respect to all frontline rescue personnel. He stated that in the face of such a severe natural disaster, all sectors of society swiftly joined hands to offer aid, rapidly pooling significant support and fully demonstrating the Chinese nation’s enduring tradition and spirit of unity, mutual assistance, and shared resilience in times of adversity. Mr. Lui added that as a patriotic enterprise rooted in Macau, GEG remains committed to fulfilling its social responsibilities and responding actively to the Macau SAR Government’s call for support. GEG hopes this donation will provide timely and meaningful assistance to frontline relief efforts, helping affected compatriots overcome current challenges and heal the trauma caused by the disaster.   GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation have long remained attentive to the country’s social needs and steadfast in upholding the principle that “what is taken from the community is to be used for the good of the community” by supporting and participating in charitable causes and disaster relief initiatives. GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation extend their highest respect to all medical personnel, firefighters, rescue workers, and volunteers serving on the frontlines. They sincerely hope that, under the joint efforts and care of the Central Government, the Xizang Autonomous Regional Government, and all sectors of society, affected residents will overcome current difficulties, smoothly carry out home reconstruction, and restore normal life and production orders as soon as possible.

item.title: 澳娛綜合捐款500萬 支援西藏災區救援重建
item.description:
>
澳娛綜合捐款500萬澳門元，支援吉隆縣救災重建。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣近日遭受嚴重泥石流災害，災區同胞的安危與生活情況牽動社會各界的心。澳娛綜合對災情深表關切，並積極響應澳門政府的呼籲，今日(4日)宣佈透過澳門中聯辦捐出500萬澳門元，支援當地緊急救援、受災群眾安置及災後重建工作，為災區送上澳門社會的一份關懷與支持。 澳娛綜合常務董事何超鳳表示，作為植根澳門60多年的愛國愛澳企業，澳娛綜合一直關注國家發展和社會需要。澳娛綜合希望透過是次捐款，向災區送上關懷與支持，向受災同胞致以誠摯慰問，並向所有參與救援工作的前線人員致以崇高敬意，衷心祝願災民早日渡過難關，恢復安定生活。

item.title: 美高梅中國捐500萬 支援西藏吉隆救災善後
item.description:
>
美高梅捐500萬澳門元助西藏吉隆賑災。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣上月遭受嚴重泥石流災害，災情嚴峻，當地民眾生命財產安全遭受重大損失。為向受災同胞表達關切和支援，美高梅中國今日(4日)宣佈，透過澳門中聯辦向西藏自治區捐出500萬澳門元，以支持當地的緊急救災及善後恢復工作，冀助災區及民眾重建家園。 美高梅中國董事長及執行董事何超瓊表示，山川相連，風雨同舟。美高梅與受災同胞血濃於水，心繫一起，時刻關注災情，藉着這片心意向遇難者致以沉痛哀悼，向遇難者與失聯者家屬、受災民眾致以深切慰問，同時向全力投入搶險救援工作的前線人員致以崇高敬意；相信在中央政府和西藏自治區政府的領導下，災區人民定能走出難關，逐步恢復正常生活。

item.title: 永利澳門捐款500萬 助西藏吉隆應急救援災後重建
item.description:
>
永利捐款500萬澳門元助西藏吉隆救災重建。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣近日發生嚴重泥石流災害，造成重大人員傷亡及財產損失，災情牽動社會各界。永利澳門今日(4日)宣佈，將透過澳門中聯辦協助向災區捐款500萬澳門元，用以支援應急救援、受災群眾安置及災後重建工作。 永利澳門總裁、董事會副主席兼執行董事陳志玲表示，永利始終與國家發展同心同行。她對此次泥石流災害造成的人員傷亡及財產損失深感痛心，並向受災居民及受影響家庭致以誠摯慰問；希望透過是次捐款，為災區救援及重建工作略盡綿力，協助受災群眾渡過難關，並向所有奮戰在救援一線的人員致以崇高敬意。 永利衷心祝願災區各項救援和恢復工作順利推進，受災群眾早日重建家園，恢復正常生活秩序。

item.title: Wynn Donates MOP 5 Million to Aid Disaster Relief in Xizang

>

item.title: SJM Resorts Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction in Gyirong County
item.description:

SJM Resorts Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction in Gyirong County SJM Resorts has announced a donation of MOP 5 million through the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao SAR to support disaster relief efforts in Gyirong County in Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, which was recently struck by severe mudslides. item.title: Sands China Responsible Gaming Ambassador Training Enhances Capabilities to Identify and Intervene in Problem Gambling
item.description:
>
Sands China Responsible Gaming Ambassador Training Enhances Capabilities to Identify and Intervene in Problem Gambling To actively support the Macau SAR Government’s policy vision and foster the sustainable development of the integrated tourism and leisure industry, Sands China hosted its 11th Advanced Responsible Gaming Ambassador Training Program on August 24 and 25 at The Londoner Macao. The program provided systematic, professional training for 42 Responsible Gaming Ambassadors from various departments, further enhancing the frontline team’s awareness in recognizing gambling disorders and their professional ability to offer timely intervention and support.   The training utilized flexible and diverse instructional methods, including lectures, scenario videos, interactive games, practical role-playing, and evaluations, featuring lectures by renowned experts. Professor Alan Feldman, Chairman of the Nevada Advisory Committee on Problem Gambling, analyzed the causes of problem gambling and coping techniques from scientific and historical perspectives. Professor Davis Fong, Director of the Institute for the Study of Commercial Gaming at the University of Macau, provided an in-depth analysis of the latest implementation status and future trends of Macau’s responsible gaming policies. Senior counselors from the Sheng Kung Hui Macau Social Services Coordination Office shared practical experiences, teaching the four-step “FACE” model for handling gambling scenarios. Upon completion, participants were awarded professional certificates issued by the International Gaming Institute at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.   Wilfred Wong, Executive Vice Chairman of Sands China, stated that promoting responsible gaming is the cornerstone of corporate social responsibility and sustainable industry development. He expressed his gratitude to the experts for their outstanding contributions over the years and encouraged the ambassadors to integrate their learning into daily operations and community outreach.   All of Sands China’s more than 28,000 team members undergo basic responsible gaming training upon joining the company. Since launching the advanced training program in 2013, the company has trained over 1,000 participants cumulatively. As early as 2004, Sands China launched a Self-Exclusion Program and pioneered a comprehensive responsible gaming framework in 2007, continuously contributing to a healthy and rational community culture.

item.title: Wynn Palace Becomes First Resort in Macao to Enter “The World’s 50 Best Hotels” Extended List
item.description:
>
Wynn Palace Becomes First Resort in Macao to Enter "The World’s 50 Best Hotels" Extended List Wynn Palace has been named No. 96 on The World’s 50 Best Hotels 2026 extended 51–100 list, becoming the first integrated resort in Macao to be recognized by this prestigious accolade. This international distinction reinforces Wynn Palace’s position as a global benchmark for luxury hospitality while further enhancing Macao’s international influence as a “World Centre of Tourism and Leisure.”   The World’s 50 Best Hotels extended 51–100 list was curated by The World’s 50 Best Hotels Academy. Marking its second edition following its introduction in 2025, the extended list features benchmark-setting hotels from six continents. The selection was made by a global panel of more than 800 independent industry experts chosen for their deep insight into the international hotel landscape.   Located in Cotai, Macau, Wynn Palace is part of Wynn Resorts and stands as the world’s largest Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star resort. It features rooms, suites, and villas, Macau’s largest spa, and a luxury shopping esplanade, alongside iconic experiences such as the Performance Lake, SkyCab, and Illuminarium. On the culinary front, the resort houses multiple renowned restaurants, including Chef Tam’s Seasons, the only restaurant in Macau featured on the Asia’s 50 Best Restaurants list, fully showcasing Macau’s unique charm as a Creative City of Gastronomy.   Earning international recognition for its bespoke luxury service and world-class culinary experiences, Wynn Palace continues to showcase the strength and excellence of Macao’s resort industry to the world.

item.title: Judicial Police Step Up Crackdown on Casino Crime; Multiple Arrests Made for Illegal Lending and Money Exchange
item.description:
>
Judicial Police Step Up Crackdown on Casino Crime; Multiple Arrests Made for Illegal Lending and Money Exchange The Judicial Police recently uncovered an illegal lending case involving “matching-fund” gambling, arresting a mainland Chinese man and woman while actively pursuing another male suspect currently on the run.   According to the case details, the arrested pair reached a “matching-fund” agreement with a gambler. Both sides contributed HK$500,000 to play baccarat, under the condition that the loan shark syndicate would skim 20% of the bet amount as interest whenever the gambler won a hand. When the victim’s chips were reduced to HK$880,000, a heated argument broke out over the interest calculation. By that time, approximately HK$200,000 in interest had already been forcibly deducted from the victim. Casino security guards on site intervened upon noticing the dispute and alerted the Judicial Police, who took the involved parties in for investigation.   Separately, the Judicial Police intensified surprise inspections at casinos in Cotai and the NAPE district, intercepting two mainland Chinese women engaged in illegal currency exchange (commonly known as “money changers”). During the operation, police seized HK$109,000 in casino chips, HK$44,000 in cash, and two mobile phones. Police revealed that one of the suspects, a 50-year-old woman, had been conducting illegal currency exchanges in casinos multiple times since 2025, generating estimated illicit profits of around HK$120,000 to date.

item.title: 改裝衫藏手機直播百家樂代客投注 司警拘三漢檢22萬現金籌碼
item.description:
>
司警再破獲改裝衫藏手機直播百家樂代客投注的案件。 澳門路氹一間賭場本周二(9月1日)凌晨破獲一宗不法電投案，一名澳門居民及兩名內地男子涉嫌利用改裝衣物隱藏手機，在賭場偷拍賭枱進行現場直播，讓內地賭客遙距下注，被司警當場逮捕。行動共搜出價值22萬港元的現金、籌碼，以及一批作案工具。 涉案男子分別為43歲劉姓本地商人，以及37歲郭姓與29歲喬姓的內地無業男子。司警於周二凌晨接獲舉報，前往現場將正於百家樂賭枱作案的3人截獲逮捕。 經調查，2名疑犯穿着設有暗袋及暗孔的改裝上衣，將手機固定於胸前偷拍賭枱畫面，並透過直播軟件傳送給內地客人，再經微型藍牙耳機接收下注指令；另一疑犯則在旁記錄輸贏結果。3人為賺取外快鋌而走險，喬姓男子聲稱獲報酬300元人民幣，郭姓男子自8月起作案累計獲利2,500元人民幣，劉姓男子所獲利益則仍在調查中。 警方在3人身上檢獲多部手機、Wi-Fi路由器、微型耳機及改裝衣物等證物。全案已依涉嫌觸犯不法經營線上幸運博彩罪或線上互相博彩罪移送檢察院偵辦。

item.title: Smartphones Turned into 24-Hour Casinos: Philippine Representative Proposes Ban on Online Gambling Ads
item.description:
>
Smartphones Turned into 24-Hour Casinos: Philippine Representative Proposes Ban on Online Gambling Ads To protect the welfare of Filipino families, Representative Karen Hope Garcia of Cebu’s 3rd District recently filed House Bill No. 10982, the Online Gambling Advertising Prohibition Act of 2026, which aims to implement a comprehensive ban on marketing, advertising, endorsements, and sponsorships for online gambling. If passed, violators could face fines of up to 10 million pesos (approx. HK$1.35 million), license revocation, and up to three years of imprisonment.   Garcia emphasized that the ubiquity of smartphones, paired with push marketing by social media influencers, has effectively turned mobile phones into “24-hour casinos.” Citing figures from the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR), she noted that online gambling revenue was projected to reach 201.12 billion pesos in 2025, accounting for over half of total revenue and surpassing land-based casinos for the first time. Garcia criticized that this growth has been driven by advertisements and influencer posts infiltrating countless households.   Under the draft bill, the prohibition covers all platforms, including television, radio, social media, targeted search engine ads, influencer promotions, SMS marketing, and sports sponsorships. Furthermore, public figures who illegally endorse these platforms will face fines, forfeiture of earnings, and endorsement bans lasting up to five years. Non-compliant social media platforms and internet service providers (ISP) could be fined 50,000 pesos per day or even lose their operating licenses.   However, the legislation will not affect the legality of regulated gambling. Instead, it will target marketing strategies designed to attract individuals, particularly young people and those experiencing financial difficulties. Advertising for non-online activities, such as authorized casinos, Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) lotteries and sweepstakes, horse racing, and licensed cockfighting in cockpits, will remain permitted, provided that such advertisements comply with mandatory responsible gaming advisories, content standards, and other restrictions. News reporting, academic discussions, and government communications will also be exempt from the ban.

item.title: Asia Pioneer Entertainment’s H1 Net Profit Surges 90 Fold, Aggressively Pursues Overseas Expansion
item.description:
>
Asia Pioneer Entertainment’s H1 Net Profit Surges 90 Fold, Aggressively Pursues Overseas Expansion Asia Pioneer Entertainment Holdings Limited (“APE”; Stock Code: 8400.HK), a Macau‑based enterprise listed in Hong Kong and a leading Asian supplier of Electronic Gaming Equipment (EGE), announced on 2 September 2026 its 2026 interim report and unaudited interim results for the six‑month period ended 30 June 2026 (the“Period”). Driven by strong demand for equipment replacement and technical upgrades at integrated resorts across Macau and Southeast Asia, the Company delivered notable growth in both revenue and profitability during the Period. According to the interim results, APE recorded total revenue of HK$33.93 million (H1 2025: HK$23.04 million), representing a substantial year‑on‑year increase of 47.3%. Net profit for the Period stood at approximately HK$2.30 million (H1 2025: HK$24,959), surging 90‑fold year‑on‑year, with basic earnings per share of 0.23 HK cents. Revenue from the core segment of EGE sales and technical support services reached HK$33.02 million, accounting for 97.3% of total revenue and remaining the key growth driver. In addition, APE has partnered with world‑renowned playing‑card brand BEE® to establish Macau’s first playing‑card factory, and introduced smart cash‑handling tech solutions to evolve into a full‑fledged one‑stop service provider for integrated resorts, which bodes well for the Company’s business outlook. Allen Tat‑Yan Huie, Chairman and Executive Director of APE, commented: “We are very pleased with APE’s financial performance in the first half of 2026. As Asia’s gaming and entertainment industry accelerates its shift toward high‑tech experiences and non‑gaming offerings, demand for next‑generation EGE from integrated resorts keeps rising. Our 47.3% revenue growth in the Period not only consolidates APE’s leading position in the Macau market, but also deepens our product portfolio through high‑quality partnerships. We hold full confidence in our performance for the second half and the long‑term development of regional markets.” Looking ahead to the second half of the year, APE will consolidate its core home market in Macau. Sustained new procurement and replacement orders from casino operators will reinforce the Company’s market standing and financial foundation. Meanwhile, APE will continue to tap new overseas markets in H2. The Company has submitted a licensed‑supplier application in the UAE, with regulatory feedback expected in the second half to support supply for upcoming local casino developments. In Singapore, APE is working closely with manufacturing partners on product licensing, which would enable large‑scale equipment sales upon approval. APE has also initiated supplier‑licence applications in Japan to get an early foothold for future integrated resort (IR) projects in the country. Going forward, APE will pursue product‑portfolio diversification by expanding into casino‑operation and floor‑management solution offerings, so as to further scale its operations and broaden its geographic footprint.

item.title: 金沙中國舉辦負責任博彩大使培訓 提升識別及介入博彩失調能力
item.description:
>
金沙中國舉辦負責任博彩大使進階培訓課程，為42位負責任博彩大使提供系統化的專業培訓。 為積極配合澳門政府施政理念、推動綜合旅遊休閒產業的可持續發展，金沙中國於8月24日及25日在澳門倫敦人舉辦第11屆「負責任博彩大使進階培訓課程」，為42位來自不同部門的負責任博彩大使提供系統化的專業培訓，進一步提升前線團隊識別賭博失調的認知，以及適時介入支援的專業能力。 本次培訓靈活採用短講、情景短片、互動遊戲、實戰角色扮演及考核等多元教學，並邀請多位重量級專家授課。美國內華達州問題博彩諮詢委員會主席Alan Feldman教授從科學與歷史角度，剖析問題賭博成因與應對技巧；澳門大學博彩研究所所長馮家超教授深入分析澳門負責任博彩政策的最新推行現況與發展趨勢；聖公會澳門社會服務處資深輔導員則分享實務經驗，傳授應對賭博情景的「FACE」四部曲。修畢課程的學員均獲頒美國內華達州立大學拉斯維加斯分校國際博彩學院發出的專業證書。 金沙中國行政副主席王英偉表示，推動負責任博彩是企業實踐社會責任與產業永續發展的基石，感謝各方專家多年來的卓越貢獻，並期許大使們將所學融入日常工作與社區推廣。 金沙中國全體逾28,000名員工入職時均需接受基礎負責任博彩培訓，自2013年推出進階培訓以來，已累計培訓超1,000人次。公司早在2004年即推出「自我隔離計劃」，並於2007年率先訂立完整負責任博彩計劃，持續為營造健康理性的社區文化貢獻力量。

item.title: 警冚長沙灣道非法賭場 搜獲6部釣魚機拘8男女
item.description:
>
警方搗破釣魚機非法賭場，共拘捕8名男女。(香港警方圖片) 香港警方打擊非法賭博活動再有斬獲，深水埗警區特別職務隊人員接獲情報並經縝密調查後，本周三(2日)下午採取突擊行動，搜查長沙灣道88號一單位，破獲一個懷疑隱匿於民居內的非法釣魚機賭場，共拘8人，檢獲6部釣魚機、一批賭具及小量現金賭款。 被捕8名涉案男女年齡介乎25至56歲。其中一名45歲李姓本地男子涉嫌管理賭博場所被捕；其餘3名本地男子、3名本地女子及1名內地女子則涉嫌在賭博場所內賭博被捕。一名楊姓被捕本地女子因未能提供有效證件，同時涉嫌未能出示身份證明文件。目前所有涉案人士均被扣留作進一步調查。

item.title: Hong Kong Police Raid Illegal Gambling Den, Arresting 8 People and Seizing 6 Gaming Machines
item.description:
>
Hong Kong Police Raid Illegal Gambling Den, Arresting 8 People and Seizing 6 Gaming Machines Hong Kong police have dealt another blow to illegal gambling following a targeted raid in Sham Shui Po. Acting on intelligence and extensive investigation, the Sham Shui Po District Special Duty Squad launched a surprise operation yesterday afternoon (September 2), searching a residential unit at 88 Cheung Sha Wan Road. Officers successfully dismantled an illegal fish-machine gambling den concealed inside the building, seizing six fish arcade machines, various gambling paraphernalia, and a small amount of cash.   Eight individuals aged between 25 and 56 were arrested during the operation. A 45-year-old local man named Lee was taken into custody on suspicion of “managing a gambling establishment.” The remaining seven suspects, comprising three local men, three local women, and one mainland Chinese woman, were arrested on suspicion of “gambling in a gambling establishment.” Additionally, one of the local female suspects, named Yeung, was further charged with “failing to produce proof of identity” after she was unable to present valid documentation. All individuals are currently being detained for further investigation.

item.title: 6.7億新台幣威力彩頭獎無人認領 全數歸入公益彩券盈餘
item.description:
>
6.7億新台幣威力彩頭獎逾期無人認領，全數歸入公益彩券盈餘。 據台灣媒體報導，台灣彩券公司(台彩)統計，2026年累計已有5筆電腦型彩券頭獎超過兌獎期限，總獎金高達7.04億元(新台幣、下同)，其中金額最高一筆，是今年2月12日在新竹市開出的6.7億元「威力彩」頭獎，相關奬金已全數歸入公益彩券盈餘。 根據台彩資料，相關6.7億元「威力彩」頭獎的兌獎期限至5月12日截止，但始終沒有人持彩券兌領，成為台灣公益彩券史上「相當令人惋惜的」一筆逾期頭獎。 除了「威力彩」，今年「今彩539」也有4筆今年到期的頭獎無人兌獎，包括去年10月11日在南投縣開出的800萬元、去年12月1日在高雄市開出的800萬元、今年2月27日在桃園市開出的1,000萬元，以及今年6月1日在高雄市開出的800萬元，合計3,400萬元獎金同樣因逾期未領，依法歸入公益彩券盈餘。 綜合台彩統計，自公益彩券第3屆、2008年發行以來，億元以上因中獎人未在期限內兌領而充公的獎金，累計已超過14.29億元。 台彩提醒，電腦型彩券的兌獎期限為開獎日次日起計3個月內，民眾購買彩券後應妥善保管，主動核對中獎號碼，並務必於兌獎期限內完成領獎，否則中獎彩券失效，獎金將撥作公益基金。
